about: Shrines where Tiny Speck's 2011-2012 street pictures show them, in every region no player's snap covers: Groddle Meadow (lane meadow2012) and 16 more (lane pins2, 2026-11-14). Read off each street's whole-street render (research/wayback/raw/street-images/<picture>, 720 px wide; reference only, never shipped): spot = the shrine's foot in street px (0, 0 = the street's top left, as street-model.js platformsScreen), good to about 25 px. Groddle Meadow's were read by eye at three times the picture's size against a street-px grid; lane pins2 matched our own CC0 shrine art against each picture and checked every hit by eye on a zoomed crop. `unread`: the shrine streets of those regions left to the planner, and why (no picture survives, or the picture shows no shrine). tools/snap-placements/shrine-pictures.mjs seats each on the floor under it and writes public/js/shrine-spots-data.js. Hand-kept: edit here, then run that tool.
